newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia trade deficit cut in first 11 months.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia trade deficit cut in first 11 months.

text.p: Tunisia's trade deficit during the first 11 months of 1996 stood at 1.95 billion dinars ($1.95 billion), down from 2.08 billion dinars during the same period last year, official figures showed on Wednesday.
Exports amounted 4.858 billion dinars, up by 4.1 percent compared with their level during the same period last year, and imports were worth 6.813 billion dinars, up 0.9 percent.

The figures, released by the National Institute of Statistics, showed that exports of the phosphates sector rose by 18.5 percent, energy by 18.9 percent, and textiles, Tunisia's main manufacturing sector exporter, by 7.8 percent. ($=one dinar)
